BiblicalUsage: Chaniyk appears once: when Abram heard his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued to Dan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is a quiet commendation: Abram's household was trained before it was ever needed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
